Nina (Sales): Heads-up: enterprise prospect wants a 12-mo reserved deal. Traffic profile: baseline ~900 RPS, bursts up to 7k RPS for ~10m. Need presales sizing, autoscale policy, and two pricing scenarios (reserve12 vs reserve20).
Ethan (AE): SLA ask: p95 <130ms, EU-only data. Likely Dedicated.
Lina (SolutionsEng): Quick numbers: avg 45 tokens, KV cache hit ~= 60%. Short requests per-GPU ~180 RPS; long-context drops throughput.
Marco (SRE): Rough calc: steady 900 -> reserve ~6 GPUs. Peak 7k -> ~40 GPUs. So options:
- Option A: reserve12 + burst to 40 (cheaper commit, higher burst risk)
- Option B: reserve20 + burst to 40 (higher commit, smoother latency)
Cass (Infra): Recommend AZ spread and prewarm schedules. For Dedicated we can enable customer KMS. Pricing differs.
Lina (SolutionsEng): Autoscale policy example: min=12 max=40 scale_up when 30s rolling rps/gpu >170, preheat cron for business hours 10m. Include fallback to smaller quantized model when queueing > threshold.
Marco (SRE): Operational notes: two-stage warm (KV then weights), rolling preheat to avoid AZ storms, scale-down cooldown 5m. I'll run perf sims with 60% KV and mixed context and return p95 & cost delta.
Nina (Sales): Please deliver numbers + single-page comparison by Tue EOD. Ethan, I'll confirm whether they prefer hosted or Dedicated and pass KV hit confirmation.
scaling-bot: perf-sim job queued: cap-sim-3112.
Marco (SRE): Quick sim result (60% KV): Option A -> p95 ~135ms at peak; Option B -> p95 ~118ms. Cost delta ~1.6x reserved charges for option B vs A (hosted). Detailed $s to follow.
Lina (SolutionsEng): I'll draft the short runbook and the autoscale JSON snippet.
Nina (Sales): Thanks team :thumbsup:
Ethan (AE): Adding note for legal: include graceful degradation language for saturated capacity.
